dog.description_text:
My foster writes: Jack-Jack is an adorable, adventurous cat that loves to find comfy places to lounge. She is very curious and likes to play with balls, find new corners of the room and look at the view outside the window. But she's also a home body and can find the most comfy places in the house to sleep and lounge in. Every night she likes to sleep under your feet in the bed!

Another foster writes: Jack-Jack is a friendly, vocal, and playful companion. She loves greeting houseguests, pulling up a chair at gatherings, accompanying her humans around the house, and saying hello with morning greetings. Despite our efforts, she is not a lap cat, BUT she will hangout right next to you while you go about life.

She stores up her energy during the day and enjoys zoomies when the sun sets. Her favorite toy is the laser pointer. Jack jack will quite literally jump off the walls to go after it. She's something of a parkour athlete.

Jack jack is also a huge fan of butt patts, and she has a severe case of elevator butt. Meaning, she arches her butt up as you pat her - sometimes to the point where she will hop on one leg as if she's going to start levitating upwards.
